content.text:
Let's shape eases on Title, the layer you eased in your easing lessons. It has three Position moves (0.5 to 1.5 s, 1.5 to 3 s and 3 to 4.37 s) and its Scale from 0.5 to 1.5 s.

You've hidden Old Take, so I'll leave it out unless you want it. CTRL is a null, so its move can't be seen in a frame. I can't see inside Icon yet. An expression drives Logo's Rotation, so changes in the graph won't show. Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position and Glow's Blurriness still need easing; that's the easing lesson.

Before we start: should any of Title's moves land hard, like an impact or a slam?

The sideways reach of a keyframe's handle is its influence: how long the ease lasts. I shaped Title's Position from 0.5 s to 1.5 s with a short ease out of the start and a long ease into the landing. Edit > Undo reverses it. In the speed graph, you'll see the peak of that move has shifted toward the start. The other three moves are yours: Title's Position from 1.5 to 3 s and from 3 to 4.37 s, and its Scale. Say done when you've shaped them.

You'll remember this much better if you shape them yourself, and I'll check each one when you're done. Shape Title's Position from 1.5 to 3 s and from 3 to 4.37 s, and its Scale, so each starts quickly and lands softly, then say done.

The move from 0.5 to 1.5 s still has my demo shape on it. Title's Position from 1.5 to 3 s and from 3 to 4.37 s, and its Scale, still have the default Easy Ease shape. Make each landing ease clearly longer than its start, then say done.
